sources.interpretation: Factual short 란 lists 이다/아니다 or 시/더/으리, distinct from command. Previous engine accepted only copular stems or 더 in the literal path, accidentally omitting noncopular honorific 시. Exact source examples 작으리란 and 모였더란 remain; no new corpus gold fabricated.

Full source notes and all examples read. Bundled 더라는데 is a reduction of 더라고 하는데 and attaches to predicates/copula or 시/었/겠. Existing split 더 + 라는데 is already a documented compositional interpretation in COV-017v, not a newly discovered unlicensed path.

Full source notes and all examples read. The polite factual entry lists 시/더/으리, wider than short 라는데. The command sense has an internally inconsistent coda note versus examples; do not use that unrelated sense to decide factual attachment.

Pinned source lists 시/더/으리, but examples only demonstrate copular uses. NIKL 318485 cites the standard dictionary with 시 only and supplies no direct noncopular honorific example. Retention tests represent pinned-source hypotheses, not adjudication of modern normative usage.
Normative prefinal restriction for 라서 explicitly deferred pending authoritative clarification. Neither rejecting all disputed hypotheses nor declaring them contextually grammatical is justified here.

decisions: Use recovered prefinal ownership, not lexical spelling: 계시란 does not infer an internal 시 marker from lexical 계시다. Unknown 계다 + 시 hypotheses remain available.
Honorific 시 + 란 now parallels full factual 시 + 라는. Keep command 으란, copular and nominal alternatives. Propagate through existing irregular recovery, auxiliaries and 답다 derivation.
The 51-cell matrix records 42 source-listed paths and nine unlisted/ungenerated combinations. Those nine absences are not automatically linguistic negative judgments.
No new global prefinal ban: the COV-017v source interpretation already explains 더 + 라는데 and conjectural 으리 + 라는데.
Three newly scoped inventory dispositions cover 라 (80212), 라면 (68832) and 라서 (80211), with explicit semantic and source-conflict limits.

unjudged_interpretation: Unjudged outputs are not certified correct. Reproduce with examples/evaluate_validity on the factual-prefinals-* cases from tests/fixtures/validity.json; all case IDs and source URLs are persistent.

corpus_discovery.search: 시란 in KAIST/GSD train and dictionary example groups
corpus_discovery.result: No independently annotated honorific short-quotation example found. Train hits were nominal 시란/서정시란 or proper-name 기시란; dictionary matches were longer 란다 copular forms. Tests use explicit source-note composition and remain agent-authored.

verification: Focused source matrix, whole raw/policy ledgers, full Rust/web suite and Nix release tests passed, including all 30 stress snapshots and the memory-limited stress case.
Pinned full-corpus regression gate, before/after frozen-corpus evaluation, Clippy with warnings denied, formatting and TypeScript/Vite build passed.
Complete browser/HTTP suite passed: all 63 raw cases, five selected factual/command/auxiliary/derived/copular paths, short-quotation source selection, dictionary filtering and JSON export parity.
Nix flake check and explicit CLI/web builds passed on x86_64-linux; other declared architectures were not built.

Packaged full-KRDict preview passed all 63 raw and three policy cases with both filters, including missing-head exclusion while retaining raw identity. Five selected paths, source links, API/CLI/export parity and no page errors verified. Both fixture and packaged desktop/mobile screenshots inspected.
Generated inventory verification and nine unit tests passed: 287 scoped / 427 unreviewed / one gap; 352 catalog-linked and 326 judgment-cited entries. Source metadata/hashes preserved.

performance.method: Three interleaved release CLI runs per version/filter, including startup, dictionary access and JSONL serialization; stdout discarded. Linux per-child peak RSS. Measurements do not establish statistical equivalence.
